name: get_stats
description: Fetch email sending statistics (delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, etc.) for a date range. Example: get_stats({ start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

name: get_blocks
description: List email addresses that have been blocked by SendGrid. These are emails that were rejected due to receiving server issues. Example: get_blocks({ limit: 50, _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })

name: get_bounces
description: List email addresses that have bounced. Includes bounce reason and timestamp. Example: get_bounces({ limit: 100, _apiKey: "SG.xxx" })
